headline: Commission: How it assesses Greece in the first report on Minimum Wages and Collective Agreements
summary: The European Commission published its first assessment of the Adequate Minimum Wages Directive. Extremely low coverage by collective labour agreements is identified as a stumbling block for Greece.
why: Minimum wage rules and collective bargaining coverage shape labour costs and wage-setting across EU economies, which matters for employers and labour-market investors.
